FN-BY191JJ-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 90
Committee: Healthcare Sponsor: Senator David Sessions
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 01/20/2026
Senate Bill 90 as introduced would decrease receipts to the Department of Conservation and
Natural Resources (DNCR) by an estimated $4,800 per fiscal year, by expanding the amount of
seafood licenses that qualify resident license holders to purchase the annual seafood dealer
license for a $265 fee, instead of the $465 fee. According to DCNR, this bill would qualify
approximately 24 additional residents for the reduced rate.
